entries.title: Psalms 38:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.>> Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

entries.title: Psalms 38:2
segments: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand cometh down upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:3
segments: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; no peace in my bones, because of my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 38:4
segments: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: as a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:5
segments: My wounds stink, they are corrupt, because of my foolishness.

entries.title: Psalms 38:6
segments: I am depressed; I am bowed down beyond measure; I go mourning all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 38:7
segments: For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.

entries.title: Psalms 38:8
segments: I am faint and broken beyond measure; I roar by reason of the agitation of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 38:9
segments: Lord, all my desire is before thee, and my sighing is not hid from thee.

entries.title: Psalms 38:10
segments: My heart throbbeth, my strength hath left me; and the light of mine eyes, it also is no more with me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:11
segments: My lovers and mine associates stand aloof from my stroke; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

entries.title: Psalms 38:12
segments: ¶And they that seek after my life lay snares [for me]; and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 38:13
segments: But I, as a deaf [man], hear not; and am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 38:14
segments: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

entries.title: Psalms 38:15
segments: For in thee, Jehovah, do I hope: *thou* wilt answer, O Lord my God.

entries.title: Psalms 38:16
segments: For I said, Let them not rejoice over me! When my foot slipped, they magnified [themselves] against me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:17
segments: For I am ready to halt, and my pain is continually before me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:18
segments: For I will declare mine iniquity, I am grieved for my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 38:19
segments: But mine enemies are lively, they are strong; and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied:

entries.title: Psalms 38:20
segments: And they that render evil for good are adversaries unto me; because I pursue what is good.

entries.title: Psalms 38:21
segments: Forsake me not, Jehovah; O my God, be not far from me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:22
segments: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
